signature.scope: Explicit conditional portable disposition for known baseline fields/assets. This is a policy signature, not a cryptographic/user authorization or product qualification.
signature.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON object with exactly keys fields, assets, portablePolicy; values are this document fieldDispositions, assetDispositions, portablePolicy. Recursively sort object keys by Unicode code point; preserve array order; JSON compact separators comma and colon; no ASCII escaping (ensure_ascii=false); no trailing newline. SHA-256 hex of these bytes. Signature and verification metadata are excluded.

legacyEvidence: CodeGraph initProjectDatabase/createTables does not set desktop user_version.
Scoped electron/src/scripts text check found no existing user_version/application_id use.
Independent Node SQLite memory probe read user_version=0. DSH schema is excluded.
schemaLane.fingerprintPolicy: Version zero alone is never recognized. S04 supplies explicit structural schema fingerprints with source evidence; do not infer known fork from missing columns. Unknown/newer/corrupt schemas reject before writable transaction.

ordering: one synchronous transaction per step: re-probe, migrate, integrity/foreign-key/domain/fingerprint verify, version write
runnerContract.restart: Previously committed steps remain committed; re-probe actual version and fingerprint. Failed current step and user_version roll back together. Never reapply committed business backfill on same-schema reopen.
adapterRequirements: Already authorized exclusive source/staging handle owned by S04.
transaction is synchronous, atomic and rolls back DDL/data/user_version on any throw or failed commit.
read methods never mutate, acquire lease, fence sessions, instantiate repositories or create files.
business migrate functions do not change user_version, open second registry, commit independently or perform live filesystem writes. M05 only verified staging capability.
runnerContract.sameSchemaReopen: Run target-version read-only domain verification on every reopen; do not rerun migration/backfill. A registered fingerprint alone is not domain verification.

portablePolicy.authorText: Preserve original bytes, including literal path-like words; no regex redaction of author prose.
portablePolicy.currentAuthority: TransferReadableAuthority preserves current accepted author and source-verified derived readable facts in new project identity. Only missing/ambiguous/replaced-source derived becomes stale. It grants no execution/model/outbox authority.
portablePolicy.executionHistory: PortableExecutionHistory is nonReplayable=true. Unknown dispatched liabilities stay reserved and are never released/replayed.
portablePolicy.receipts: Only wholly portable original receipt bytes may carry original digest. Any credential/secretRef/machine path/grant byte requires excluding original bytes AND digest/MAC; emit only redactedProjection, projectionHash, excludedFieldNames, safe terminal state/domain IDs, nonReplayable=true, originalReceiptVerified=false.
portablePolicy.sourceHash: Original author/finalized-content hashes may transfer only for permitted author bytes; never reintroduce metadata/secret hashes via transfer authority.
portablePolicy.exportEnablement: B01 validates each value and nested schema against signed policy, S04 snapshot, M05 and ownership gates. Conditional signed policy is not unconditional permission to export every SQL row.
